capabilities: render the whole vault as a 3D node graph
open a note by clicking its node
drag nodes to arrange a persistent layout
show live updates when links are added
display the open note's link count in a sidebar panel
extras: Vaults over 1,500 notes only draw their first 1,500 notes; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later on desktop only; the plugin never modifies notes, storing layout in its own settings.
motivation: The README does not state a motivation beyond promoting the Filamental companion app.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is 2D, so users who want to see and arrange their vault's link structure in 3D have no option.

relations.evidence: It comes from the team behind Filamental, the desktop companion app that opens this same vault folder.

summary: A 3D force-directed vault graph where notes are nodes, wikilinks are connectors, and physics settles the layout.
